Reservation Reminder for East Potomac Golf Links - WHITE Course
description: 96 Confirmation# 425007760 Hi Esther Scott , Your reservation is tomorrow at 8:40 am. East Potomac Golf Links - WHITE Course Sunday, June 28, 2026 8:40 am 2 Player(s) A Note from National Links Trust: We are devastated to share that the Trump administration has terminated National Links Trust’s lease, effective immediately. In the short term, NLT has agreed to stay on as operators, allowing our courses to remain open and our hundreds of dedicated employees to stay in place. However, the future of affordable, accessible, high-quality public golf in the District is bleak. This is not the update we wanted to share. As a DC golfer, you know how special the East Potomac, Langston, and Rock Creek courses are. While this termination is a major setback, we remain stubbornly hopeful that a path forward can be found that preserves affordable and accessible public golf in the nation’s capital for generations to come. PlayDCgolf and NLT remain fully committed to honoring the legacies and principles of DC’s historic public courses. We hope that you stand with us and continue to share your love of DC public golf with friends, family, and beyond. Tee Time Cancellation Policy: Please log into the tee time booking portal at least 2 hours in advance to cancel or reduce the number of players to your tee time. Questions about your reservation? Call us at (202) 554-7660. Book Next Round Visit Our Website East Potomac Golf Links - WHITE Course 972 Ohio Dr SW, Washington, DC 20024, US (202) 554-766

title: Continued Technical Difficulties - Communications
description:
Good morning!

We are still currently experiencing intermittent phone outages
(both incoming and outgoing) - please feel free to give the
clinic a call and we'll answer if able! Otherwise, while we
continue to work to get things fixed you can reliably contact us
either via email or our text line!

Email: contact@suburbananimalhospital.net

Text: 757-821-5252

If your pet is here for an appointment or you are awaiting
contact from staff, please be sure to frequently check your email
/ texts!

Our provider estimates a full return to working services by
Monday - thank you for your understanding!
